facts.fact: The Finance Act 2020 sets monthly or per-transaction fees for the National Civil Registration Secretariat's electronic Know Your Customer service, payable by banks, microfinance, credit reference, passport, driver licence, NRA/tax, NaSSIT, councils, lands, WAEC, universities and mobile companies.
The Act's eKYC fee schedule lists users in banking, telecoms (mobile company), tax, social security, education, lands and licensing.

note: Fee schedule only; no figure for verifications made. Act is dated 2020 (in operation 1 January 2020).
